components.description: full-bleed brand-purple hero with serif display headline
three plain tiers separated by a brand top border

review: FixtureCo demonstrates restraint: a single brand purple carries the entire identity while a serif display face does the emotional work. Sections breathe with generous vertical padding, and the pricing block earns attention through a lone accent border rather than cards or shadows. Worth stealing: the one-accent-color discipline and the serif/sans tension. The dark header/footer bracket gives the page a solid frame without heavy chrome. Weaknesses: feature prose is undifferentiated and the nav offers no hierarchy, but as a study in doing more with less this holds up well beyond its size.
